verification.note: addons/cloud-sync/backend/requirements.txt:2-3 holds the comment about legacy zone names (Asia/Calcutta) and an unpinned `tzdata`. The only other line is line 1, `croniter>=2.0,<4.0`. The Dockerfile copies each addon's backend/ to addons/<name> (backend/Dockerfile:10-14) and then pip-installs addons/*/requirements.txt (backend/Dockerfile:21-23), so tzdata ends up in the backend image. The spec says otherwise at docs/specs/cloud-sync-settings-gui.md:371-372: 'No new dependency: `zoneinfo` and `croniter` are already available in the backend image'. The touch-point list (spec line 374 onward) does not name requirements.txt. invariants.md has no revision that mentions requirements or tzdata. I could not run git, so I did not see the diff that adds the line. The comment refers to browser-reported zones, which is this feature's time-zone selection, so the line is consistent with having been added by this change.

addons/cloud-sync/backend/settings.py exists. It defines `class BodyCheck` (line 53), `BodyCheck.to_config` (line 61) and `check_body` (line 73). service.py:28 imports it with `from .settings import ConfigError, check_body`. The spec's touch points put 'the PUT body validation that collects every error' in `backend/schemas.py` and do not name settings.py, and no revision in invariants.md adds it. I could not confirm through git that the file is new in this commit.

All three files exist: addons/cloud-sync/frontend/settingsApi.ts, settingsDraft.ts and scheduleForm.ts. The settings component imports them from outside its own directory: CloudSyncSettingsContainer.tsx:5-6 imports `fetchConfig`/`saveConfig` from ../settingsApi and `toBody`/`toDraft` from ../settingsDraft, and ScheduleFields.tsx:2 imports from ../scheduleForm. They sit beside the CloudSyncSettings/ component directory, not inside it. The touch points name only the section component, slots.ts, api.ts, CloudSyncWidget.tsx, SyncDriveCard.tsx, the messages files and tests. I did not check through git that api.ts changes only `SyncStatusResponse.timezone`.

specification_compliance: The spec's non-functional item (docs/specs/cloud-sync-settings-gui.md:371) says the change adds no new dependency, but addons/cloud-sync/backend/requirements.txt adds `tzdata`.
The touch-point list does not name backend/settings.py, frontend/settingsApi.ts, frontend/settingsDraft.ts, frontend/scheduleForm.ts or backend/requirements.txt.
potential_unspecified_behavior: Because `tzdata` is unpinned, the zone database in the image depends on build time. Which zones validate could therefore differ between builds.
regression_risks: The Dockerfile installs every addons/*/requirements.txt, so adding tzdata changes the contents of the backend image.
test_coverage: I did not assess test coverage. This verification was limited to the three touch-point findings.
not_verified: I could not run git diff, so I did not confirm that tzdata, settings.py, settingsApi.ts, settingsDraft.ts and scheduleForm.ts were introduced by commit 230fc0b rather than earlier.
Whether the slim image's zoneinfo lacks the legacy zone names without the tzdata package.
